title: Πόλεις του κόσμου
description: Columns, a profile and an interview from cities of the world: Rome's potholes, Genoa's pesto, a psychiatrist in Vienna, CERN near Geneva, Singapore's airport, a Greek diner in New York, ancient Greek Marseille, ageing Tokyo, rebetiko in Istanbul and the stars of Isfahan.

lessons.title: Οι λακκούβες της Ρώμης
lessons.summary: A traveller in Rome visits the Colosseum and a model of the ancient city, and reflects on potholes, unplanned building and the city's layers.

lessons.title: Το πέστο της Γένοβας
lessons.summary: A visit to a small family restaurant in old Genoa, where the owner makes pesto, pasta and focaccia by hand for a local clientele.

lessons.title: Μια ψυχίατρος στη Βιέννη
lessons.summary: An interview with a Greek psychiatrist in Vienna about her training, the history of psychiatry and today's treatments.

lessons.title: Μια μέρα στο CERN
lessons.summary: A journalist spends a day at CERN near Geneva with a Greek physicist who studies quarks.

lessons.title: Δεκατέσσερις ώρες στη Σιγκαπούρη
lessons.summary: A traveller with a fourteen-hour stopover discovers that Singapore's airport is a destination of its own.

lessons.title: Το μαγαζί του παππού στη Νέα Υόρκη
lessons.summary: A grandchild writes the story of the Greek diner their grandparents ran in Astoria, New York.

lessons.title: Ένας έφορος στη Μασσαλία
lessons.summary: A retired Greek archaeologist visits Marseille, the city ancient Greek colonists founded, and its history museum.

lessons.title: Ένας χρόνος στο Τόκιο
lessons.summary: A Greek teacher living in Tokyo writes about crowded trains, spring pollen, an ageing neighbourhood and the small signs of its renewal.

lessons.title: Ρεμπέτικο στην Πόλη
lessons.summary: Two friends go looking for rebetiko in Istanbul and find pickles, porcelain, Hebrew inscriptions and an old singer in a tavern.

lessons.title: Τα αστέρια του Ισφαχάν
lessons.summary: A traveller in Isfahan admires the tiled mosques and a Persian garden, and learns about a tenth-century astronomer who first described the Andromeda 'nebula'.
